title: Flint and Steel
statementMd:
Steve's creeper farm has overflowed and there are creepers everywhere! There are $n$ creepers standing in a line, with the $i$-th creeper having explosive power $e_i$. Steve needs to kill all of them in order to get past.

To do this, he can use his trusty Flint and Steel to *detonate* creepers. Detonating the creeper at position $i$ kills all creepers at positions $j$ such that $|i - j| \lt e_i$. Dead creepers cannot be detonated. Some creepers may be particularly weak and have explosive power $0$, meaning they cannot be detonated either.

With the Great Hog hot on his tail, there is no time to waste. Find a sequence of detonations that kills all the creepers with as few detonations as possible, or report it is impossible.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of creepers.

The second line of each test case contains $n$ integers $e_1, e_2,\ldots, e_n$ ($0 \le e_i \le n$) — the explosive power of each creeper.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $5 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output $-1$ if it is impossible to kill all the creepers.

Otherwise, output two lines. On the first line, output a single integer $k$ ($1 \leq k \leq n$), the minimum number of detonations needed. Then output a line with $k$ integers $d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_k$ ($1 \leq d_i \leq n$), stating the sequence of creepers to detonate.

If there are multiple solutions, you can print any of them.

## Note

In the first test case, the sequence of detonations is as follows:

- $\underline{0, \mathbf{2}, 2}, 3, 0, 1$
- $\times, \underline{\times, \times, \mathbf{3}, 0, 1}$
- $\times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$

where $\times$ represents a dead creeper. Note that if Steve had first detonated creeper $4$ instead, the only creeper left alive would be creeper $1$ which cannot be detonated.

In the second test case, creeper $1$ cannot be detonated, and none of creepers $2$, $3$ or $4$ have a high enough explosive power to kill it, so there is no solution.

In the fifth test case, the sequence of detonations is as follows:

- $\underline{\mathbf{2}, 0}, 2, 4, 2, 2, 4, 1, 1$
- $\times, \times, 2, \underline{4, 2, 2, \mathbf{4}, 1, 1}$
- $\times, \underline{\times, \mathbf{2}, \times}, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$
- $\times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$
statementZhMd:
Steve 的苦力怕农场泛滥成灾，苦力怕到处都是！有 $n$ 只苦力怕站成一排，第 $i$ 只苦力怕的爆炸威力为 $e_i$。Steve 必须把它们全部消灭才能通过。

为此，他可以用他那可靠的打火石来*引爆*苦力怕。引爆位置 $i$ 处的苦力怕会杀死所有位置 $j$ 满足 $|i - j| \lt e_i$ 的苦力怕。已经死亡的苦力怕不能被引爆。有些苦力怕可能特别弱，爆炸威力为 $0$，这意味着它们同样不能被引爆。

大神猪在身后紧追不舍，没有时间可以浪费。请找出一个能消灭所有苦力怕的引爆序列，并使引爆次数尽可能少；如果不可能，则报告无解。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$ ($2 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^5$) — 表示苦力怕的数量。

每个测试用例的第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $e_1, e_2,\ldots, e_n$ ($0 \le e_i \le n$) — 表示每只苦力怕的爆炸威力。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $5 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，如果无法消灭所有苦力怕，输出 $-1$。

否则，输出两行。第一行输出一个整数 $k$ ($1 \leq k \leq n$)，表示所需的最少引爆次数。随后输出一行，包含 $k$ 个整数 $d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_k$ ($1 \leq d_i \leq n$)，表示要引爆的苦力怕序列。

如果有多个解决方案，你可以输出其中任意一个。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，引爆序列如下：

- $\underline{0, \mathbf{2}, 2}, 3, 0, 1$
- $\times, \underline{\times, \times, \mathbf{3}, 0, 1}$
- $\times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$

其中 $\times$ 表示已死亡的苦力怕。注意，如果 Steve 当初先引爆的是苦力怕 $4$，那么最后存活的将只有无法被引爆的苦力怕 $1$。

在第二个测试用例中，苦力怕 $1$ 无法被引爆，而苦力怕 $2$、$3$、$4$ 的爆炸威力都不足以杀死它，因此无解。

在第五个测试用例中，引爆序列如下：

- $\underline{\mathbf{2}, 0}, 2, 4, 2, 2, 4, 1, 1$
- $\times, \times, 2, \underline{4, 2, 2, \mathbf{4}, 1, 1}$
- $\times, \underline{\times, \mathbf{2}, \times}, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$
- $\times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times, \times$
